title: The Guy Lombardo saxophone sound and vibrato versus tremolo
summary: Armstrong liked a Lombardo-like sax vibrato; Randolph voiced differently and explains moderation and steady vibrato versus tremolo.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

When you make the vibrato not a tremolo, though, it's -- the thing about it, the vibrato and a tremolo is two different things. And a vibrato should be steady just as well as you steady tone. See, a lot of people think that you just going to take the horn and oo-oo-oo-oo- No, you've got to steady -- do-do-do-do- You've got to make it sing, you've got to make the horn sing.
